So far, so good. Only some insignificant fixes were required :)

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Style**
  - Improved code clarity in test files by replacing short-circuit expressions with explicit conditional statements.

- **Chores**
  - Updated ESLint configuration to enforce errors for unused expressions in TypeScript files.

- **Tests**
  - Adjusted test callbacks to explicitly return accessed property values, ensuring clearer test behavior.
## Walkthrough

The changes update TypeScript benchmark tests to ensure property accesses are returned, revise test helper functions in decoder tests to use explicit `if` statements instead of short-circuit evaluation, and add a new ESLint rule to enforce errors on unused expressions in TypeScript files. No public API or exported entity signatures were altered.

## Changes

| File(s)                                             | Change Summary                                                                                                 |
|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| benchmarks/codec/view_vs_object.ts                  | Modified test callbacks to explicitly return accessed properties, affecting how results are handled in tests.  |
| packages/core/codec/decoder.test.ts                 | Replaced short-circuit logical ANDs with explicit `if` statements for conditional method calls in helpers.     |
| eslint.config.mjs                                   | Added `"no-unused-expressions": "error"` rule for TypeScript files to enforce error on unused expressions.     |
